title: Responsive Company Website Architecture
overview: A lightweight, high-performance static corporate website providing Home, About, Services, and Contact pages built with Astro and Tailwind CSS. It is hosted on a global edge CDN via Netlify, featuring seamless cross-device responsiveness and integrated form handling without requiring a dedicated backend server.

nodes.label: Prospective Clients
nodes.purpose: End users browsing company information and submitting inquiries.

nodes.label: Corporate Website
nodes.purpose: Renders pre-built static HTML pages for Home, About, Services, and Contact.

nodes.label: Styling Engine
nodes.purpose: Applies utility-first responsive layout rules for desktop and mobile viewports.

nodes.label: Form Handler
nodes.purpose: Processes contact form submissions securely without a custom backend server.

nodes.label: Static CDN
nodes.purpose: Delivers global edge caching and atomic deployments for static assets.

nodes.label: Security Headers
nodes.purpose: Enforces HTTPS transport and strict Content Security Policy headers.

requirement_mapping.requirement: Contact page with a message submission UI
Responsive layout adjusting to screen sizes

assumptions: Contact form submissions can be handled via a third-party service like Formspree or static mailto links since there is no backend.
Branding guidelines and finalized copywriting will be supplied prior to development.
Users will access the site primarily via modern browsers supporting CSS Grid and Flexbox.

technology_stack.purpose: Static site generation delivering zero JavaScript by default for high performance.
Utility-first CSS framework for rapid and responsive design implementation.
Global edge CDN and continuous deployment for static frontend assets.
Serverless contact form message processing service.
Enforces HTTPS and strict Content Security Policy headers.

security_considerations: Apply strict Content Security Policy (CSP) headers to prevent unauthorized script execution.
Ensure all third-party integrations use HTTPS and validate inputs safely.
Avoid storing sensitive credentials or API keys in client-side code.
Protect against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via framework-level automatic escaping.
scalability_considerations: Leverage global edge caching to effortlessly handle standard corporate website traffic spikes.
Serve pre-rendered static HTML to minimize compute overhead and guarantee fast load times.
Optimize media assets using modern formats like WebP or AVIF to preserve bandwidth.
future_enhancements: Integrate a headless CMS for easy non-technical content management.
Add multi-language localization support for international audiences.
Implement automated visual regression testing within the CI/CD pipeline.
